text:
maya: Heads-up — postmortem for the 03/20 inference-degradation is out. We need to convert remediation items into concrete tests and owners. Can we capture owners, timelines, and which suites get extended? :clipboard:
owen: I skimmed the PM. Two big asks: (1) add regression test for the prefix-cache edge case, (2) add a load/soak job for 10k concurrent short requests. I can take the regression test if no objections.
li: I can take the load/soak job. Prefer using k6 so it runs in our CI and can be scheduled from monitoring.
samar: For chaos drills — earlier incidents show a recurring pattern: KV-cache eviction under bursty traffic. Suggest a targeted chaos test that kills nodes and verifies fallback routing within 30s.
eva: I'll own the prompt-set augmentation. Need to bake inputs that trigger the cache-miss long-tail (I can produce ~50 cases). ETA 1 week.
maya: Great. Can we put timelines in this thread and the GH issue? I want a canary-run in staging before next deploy.
owen: Timeline: regression test PR by EOD Friday (1976642001 + 5 days). I'll open branch and include a small unit harness.
li: Load job plan: k6 script + GitHub Action schedule. I'll draft a job like:
```
name: incident-load
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1' # weekly
jobs:
  run-load:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run_k6 --script k6/10k_short.js
```
li: I'll aim to have the action and a dashboard by next Wednesday.
oncall-bot: Incident PM-2026-03-20 created by @maya. Linked: https://pm.redwood/company/PM-4567
samar: For chaos drill owner, I'm +1. I'll run an initial tabletop and then a live drill in staging. Proposed window: next Tuesday 10am PT. Owner: samar. Steps: fail replica, observe fallback, measure 95p latency and error rate.
owen: Quick note — include a small eval that checks output quality after fallback routing (model variant swap). We don't want silent regressions.
eva: Where should I push the prompt set? I can put them under repo: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/prompt-sets/pm-4567-3-20
maya: Perfect. Owners and rough timelines:
- Regression unit + PR: owen — by Friday
- Load/soak k6 + scheduled GH Action and dashboards: li — by next Wed
- Prompt-set augmentation & evals: eva — by 1 week
- Chaos drill (tabletop + staging run): samar — next Tue 10am PT
- Cross-check model-swap quality tests: owen + eva — add to regression plan
maya: Also assign a follow-up to eng-sre to add a recurring detection rule for KV eviction spikes (monthly check). @li can you coordinate with SRE?
li: Yep, I'll ping eng-sre and add an RFC to the ops tracker.
owen: I'll open a GH issue linking the PM and add labels: incident-regression, priority-high, owner-owen.
eva: PR for prompt sets will include a small eval harness and expected-pass thresholds.
samar: I'll draft the chaos drill playbook and share in #eng-oncall, then tag ops for runbook updates.
maya: Thanks all. Can everyone drop a short comment in the GH issue when their PR/plan is created so we can count blockers in the weekly follow-up? :eyes:
li: done.
owen: done.
eva: will do.
samar: will do.
maya: Closing the loop — plan review sync next Friday 9am PT to verify staging canary results and remaining items. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
